playoff.entries: 16th of Ligue 1 vs winner of the Ligue 2 promotion play-offs (Ligue 2 3rd-5th)
playoff.note: away goals not applied; extra time then penalties

playoff.entries: 3rd-5th single-match bracket (5th at 4th, then 3rd at home); winner vs 16th of Ligue 1
playoff.note: internal bracket is one match per round, only the final tie vs Ligue 1 is two legs; the 16th also plays a relegation play-off vs the Ligue 3 play-off winner

playoff.entries: 3rd-6th single-match bracket (6th at 3rd, 5th at 4th, final at the better seed); winner vs 16th of Ligue 2
playoff.note: internal bracket is one match per round, only the final tie vs Ligue 2 is two legs

boundaries.note: Ligue 2: top 2 promoted, 3rd-5th play a single-match bracket whose winner meets Ligue 1's 16th over two legs. Ligue 1: 17th-18th relegated directly, 16th in that two-leg play-off.
Ligue 3: top 2 promoted, 3rd-6th play a single-match bracket whose winner meets Ligue 2's 16th over two legs. Ligue 2: 17th-18th relegated directly, 16th in that play-off.
National 1 has 3 regional groups; each group winner is promoted (up=3). Ligue 3 relegates its bottom 3 (16th-18th) with no play-off.
National 2 has 8 regional groups of 14; the 8 group winners are promoted. National 1 sends down the 15th and 16th of each of its 3 groups (6) plus the two worst 14th-placed teams (8 total).

conflicts.note: National 1 is 48 clubs in 3 groups of 16 (30 rounds). Our 16/16/17 gives 49; group C is one club too large.

Name is correct only from 2026-27: the former Championnat National was rebranded Ligue 3 (FFF competition rules 'Ligue 3 - règlement 2026-2027'). Older rows named 'Championnat National' would be wrong at level 3.
Our level 5 carries only groups E, F and G; five groups are missing. Sizes (14) are correct.

notes: Boundaries 3-4 and 4-5 keep their real shape: 3 group winners up from National 1, 8 group winners up from National 2. Level 6 (Régional 1) is outside the model: National 2 relegates the bottom 3 of each group plus the worst 11th (25 clubs), fed by regional leagues. Ligue 1/Ligue 2/Ligue 3 are all 18 clubs and 34 rounds; National 1 is 30 rounds, National 2 is 26 rounds. Play-off ties between divisions are two legs, away goals abolished, extra time then penalties.
note: Groups A-D and H were added in 2026-11-21.
